title: COCO val2017 CCTV-relevant subset
description: 180 COCO val2017 images with CCTV-relevant content (street scenes, people from single to crowds, vehicles, bicycles, motorbikes, animals, yards and parking), 31.5 MB (31492283 bytes) in total. All 80 COCO labels are scored (coco80 spellings); iscrowd regions are ignore. CCTV focus classes: person, bicycle, car, motorbike, bus, truck, bird, cat, dog, horse. COCO images are at most 640 px on the long side (res:sd). Day/night is estimated from mean luminance (< 50/255) or a night/dark caption. Empty images are val2017 images with no annotations.
